info.name: RideShare Platform API
info.description:
Industrial Rideshare Platform — complete API collection.

## Setup
1. Set `base_url` variable to `http://localhost:3000`
2. Run **Admin Login** → token auto-saves to `admin_token`
3. Run **Rider Verify OTP** → token auto-saves to `rider_token`
4. Driver login has two paths:
   - Legacy: **Driver (legacy) — Send/Verify OTP** (phone only, no device scoping) → `driver_token`
   - Current: **Driver Mobile — Start/Verify** or **Driver Email — Start/Verify** (device-scoped via `device_id`, see `driver_devices` table) → `driver_token` + `driver_refresh_token`
5. All subsequent requests use these tokens automatically.
6. Driver onboarding order: Geo (pick country/state/city) → Update Driving Location → Documents (types → upload-url → confirm) → Onboarding (questions/answers, legal accept) → Vehicles → Submit Application → Admin Approve.

## Response Format
```json
{ "SUCCESS": true, "MESSAGE": <data> }
{ "SUCCESS": true, "MESSAGE": [...], "COUNT": n, "PAGINATION": { "currentPage", "itemsPerPage", "totalItems", "totalPages" } }
{ "SUCCESS": false, "MESSAGE": "error reason" }
```
